description: HW7 Part 2 fixed verification cases (s3209_rel). Each needs >= 2 tool calls with no follow-up prompt.

A.title: Search, then detail-lookup the first result
A.prompt: Search for Diabetes trials, then give me the full details of the first result.

B.prompt: How many trials are currently Recruiting? Then search for one recruiting Migraine trial and give it as a supporting example.

C.prompt: Compare the first two Hypertension trials: search for Hypertension, then look up both trials and compare their status and enrollment slots.
